### Storage is intentionally pluggable

The plugin never reads from

, IndexedDB, or any backend directly. Adapters are the only persistence boundary — if you need session-shared, multi-tenant, or audit-compliant storage, write an adapter and stay inside the typed contract.

### Bundle budget

The published entry has an 8 KB gzipped budget enforced in CI by

components — they live in a separate entry. This keeps the headless consumer (a CMS that only wants snapshots and audit history but ships its own UI) at the published bundle budget.

### Adapter freezing recommended

Reference adapters deep-freeze stored IRs to catch accidental mutation early. Custom adapters are not required to freeze, but doing so eliminates a class of "history snapshot mutated after save" bugs that are otherwise easy to miss.
